title: FAQ: Blue Account
summary: This document lists Blue Account FAQs including paper statement cost ($2.50/month), APY (0.01%), low-balance alerts (e.g., $62 threshold), external transfer timing (2 business days), returned check fee ($15.00), incoming domestic wire fee ($12.50). It also covers the referral program ($35 per successful referral, $30 welcome bonus), eligibility (deposit at least $500 within 60 days; 30-day minimum banking relationship), and a cap of 5 referral bonuses per calendar year.
